title: What are DEEPCRAFT™ Studio Accelerators?
description: An introduction to DEEPCRAFT™ Studio Accelerators: ready-made Studio projects with sample data, a preprocessor, and a model architecture you can adapt to your own Edge AI use case.
long_description: DEEPCRAFT™ Studio Accelerators are starter projects you can open directly in DEEPCRAFT™ Studio. Each Accelerator ships with a project to build on, relevant sample data, and a preprocessor and model architecture tailored to the use case, plus a README explaining how to collect more data and what is needed to take a model into production. More than 30 Accelerators are available across sensor types such as audio, IMU, and CAPSENSE™, with new ones added regularly, so new users can learn Studio from real examples and experienced teams can start building Edge AI products faster.
